newsitem.title: GERMANY: Saltus share offer sees heavy demand.
newsitem.headline: Saltus share offer sees heavy demand.

text.p: Germany's Saltus Technology said on Thursday that its issue of 800,000 shares for the bourse's New Market for growth stocks has been oversubscribed by more than 100 times.

Saltus said in a statement that due to the heavy demand, the close of the subscription period for the shares had been brought forward to 1200 GMT today. Previously, the firm had said the subscription period would end on July 11.
The price of the offering will be fixed on July 12 and the stock will be listed on the exchange on July 14.
Saltus, which is an engineering company, reported a net profit of 2.2 million marks for the business year ended January 31 on sales of 14.7 million marks.
